player_prompt.intro:
I ye Joueur {player_id} ye JoJoJoin, jèlèbaw ka taa 5x5 la, ka sèlèbaw 0-24.
Ni i ka wò, i bɔ i ka mariki kɔnɔ sèlèbaw kɛnɛ, nɔgɔ ' [12] '.
I YE SANOGO i ka mariki sɔrɔnna kɛnɛ si na, sɔrɔnna kɛnɛ fila fila, kɔrɔn kɔrɔn, wélé wélé, wɔɔrɔ wɔɔrɔ.
Ni Joueur {player_id} ye i, i ye '{symbol}'; i ka jagokèlè ye '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O labɛn in ma tugu sariya sɛbɛ la.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} tɛ sɛli jɛlen ye. A ka kan ka kɛ 0 ani 24 cɛ.
